metadata.title: Open Market Note #005 — ENTSO-E Cross-Border Physical Flow Dynamics Baseline
metadata.description:
Data Boundary Finding: Metric M1 High Utilization Exclusion (Rule A) and Metric M2 Intra-Corridor Physical Flow Dynamics Baseline across CWE bidding zone borders (AT-DE, BE-NL, FR-BE, NL-DE).

Package contains documentation (README.md), parameter ledger (PARAMS.md), decision ledger (DECISIONS.md), reproducible python code, summary results (results.json), figures, data manifest (data_manifest.json).

Source Data Attribution: ENTSO-E Transparency Platform Terms of Use Item #27 (CC BY 4.0 Verbatim, https://transparency.entsoe.eu/content/static_content/html/terms_of_use.html)
